load_config_default: load a config for real world experiments using the default eval.yaml preset path
load_config_custom_path: load a config for real world experiments from a custom YAML config file path
load_config_visualize: load a config with visualization enabled for real world robot experiments
load_slap_config: load a SLAP config for real world experiments from a specified YAML config path
review_load_config: review the load_config function to understand how it sets NUM_ENVIRONMENTS and VISUALIZE defaults
